```plato

// Box-plot statistics: the five-number summary plus whisker ends (the most
// extreme data values within 1.5 interquartile ranges of the quartiles) and
// the data values lying beyond the whiskers.
type BoxPlotStatistics
    implements IValue
{
    Summary: FiveNumberSummary;
    LowerWhisker: Number;
    UpperWhisker: Number;
    Outliers: Array<Number>;
}
```
